Gaw-La Furia - Throne Room
Shana-Mia
Al-Van...? Is that true?
Da-Nia
It is... He was held responsible for failing@the mission to recover the Throne Unit at Karachi.
But surely that punishment is far too harsh.
According to Gu-Landon's report,@Al-Van was plotting to collude@with the Earthlings.
A man of such deep loyalty@would never do such a thing.
And yet Sentinel Commander E-Selda Shune,@who served at your very side,@stole the Throne Unit and fled.
(That is...)
And now his pupil Al-Van has betrayed us too...@The key figures of the Assimilation Plan@have all rebelled.
Perhaps they were swayed while in contact@with the Earthlings.
Then I will meet Al-Van and question him myself.
That will not do.
You would defy my will, Chancellor?
If I may be so bold, please consider the position@of Gu-Landon, the Knight Commander.
If Your Highness shows mercy to a traitor,@it will set a poor example for the Junior Knights@and Squires.
And Gu-Landon's ruling also serves to prevent leaks@about the Assimilation Plan, which only a select@few know of.
If it came to light, there could be riots.@We must avoid such a situation in this crisis,@with the <Gate of Voda> open.
If you still insist on meeting Al-Van,@then please explain your reasons until@I, Da-Nia, am satisfied.
(I can go no further...)
(I must use this chance to have Her Highness@abandon the Assimilation Plan...)
Gaw-La Furia - Interior
Jua-Mu
Jua-Mu Dalubi, reporting as summoned.
Gu-Landon
Listen well, Jua-Mu.@I have decided to make you a Knight.
I-Is that true!?
Indeed. The formal investiture will come later,@but you shall be granted your own Raftclans@after this.
It is a precious knight unit. Use it with care.@And strive to add ever more glory@to the Furia Holy Knights.
Y-Yes, sir!
Fu-Ruu
Congratulations, Jua-Mu. Become a fine Knight.
(Now when Dad, Mom and Kudo-Ra wake up,@I can give them a good life...!)
Your first mission as a Knight is to recover@Granteed and destroy Bellzelute.
Assemble Junior Knights and Squires, and sortie.
With respect, wasn't the mission to recover@Granteed given to Lord Al-Van...?
That man has been stripped of his knighthood.
He is now in prison. He will never again pilot@a Raftclans or stand on a glorious battlefield.
B-But why?!@Lord Al-Van, stripped of his knighthood...!
Not only did he fail the mission to recover@the Throne Unit at Karachi, he plotted to collude@with the Earthlings.
Earthlings...?!@Don't tell me... Calvina Coulange?!
...That's right.
Jua-Mu, to restore the honor of the Knights,@carry out your mission with all your heart@and soul.
Th-Then, once I recover the Throne Unit@and destroy Bellzelute, will Lord Al-Van's@honor be restored...?
That will not happen.
But that's far too harsh!
In view of his past service, his punishment@stops at loss of knighthood and confinement.
By rights, he deserves a far heavier penalty.
Ugh...
Now, sortie as soon as you are ready.
At once...!
(It's that woman. Lord Al-Van's been hesitant ever@since he met her again. But she's just some Earthling@we used, isn't she?)
(It's because she's alive, and piloting that thing.@If Lord Al-Van can't do it, I'll take care of her.@With this Raftclans.)
(Then he's sure to go back@to the way he was...)
Jua-Mu.
Lady Fu-Ruu...
One thing about Al-Van. He resolved to accept@punishment partly so it wouldn't fall on you,@his direct subordinates.
(...Right, that's the kind of man he is.@Which makes that woman even more unforgivable...!)
You seem worked up. Is that anger?
Do you know why using Larseilam@is taboo for a Knight?
Because it's a tactic unfit for Knights,@who value fair and honorable combat.
Yes... Lessons from the past dictate it may not be@used except in a dire crisis, and only with@His Majesty the Emperor's permission.
Though there's also the problem of Larseilam's@core, the celestial substance Eitelum, which@can no longer be obtained...
Holding a trump card, yet choosing to fight@without relying on it, is part of a Knight's pride.
...Sir.
Break the taboo and use Larseilam out of@obsession with victory, and you'll be stripped@of your knighthood.
No matter how hard the mission,@strive to complete it without that.@Do so, and you'll become truly strong.
...I'll keep that in mind.
Earth Federation Army Southern Europe Army -@Aviano Base
Aviano Base - Hangar
...Like I figured,@Aviano Base's maintenance area is top-notch.
It's so big, I might get lost...
It even has a dock just for Space Noah-class ships.
Tsugumi
Oh, are you taking a look around too?
Yes, it's a rare opportunity.
Sounds like Lefina's detachment had a lot going on.@You fought Skull Knight and Debudedabide, right?
That's right. The latter appeared at Karachi@and captured a Lamaris Kaana.
He did the same thing in Paris, didn't he...?
Yes, in the Final Phase@of Operation Triumph.
After that, we were attacked@by the Fury's Al-Van.
So did he use that trick of his?
No. Al-Van wasn't after Granteed, but Bellzelute...@He was trying to clear up a misunderstanding@with Lieutenant Calvina.
Misunderstanding?
Yes. That he wasn't the one who@attacked <Ashurey Kreuzer>...
But according to Lieutenant Calvina,@he was there, wasn't he?
So she didn't believe him... But apparently@Ashurey was working on a plan to bring@a new future to the Fury.
What's that?
Al-Van withdrew partway through,@so we never found out.
But I wonder if it has to do with Bellzelute, which was@developed at Ashurey, and Katia, Melua and Tenia,@who were brought in to test it...
But they themselves have no idea, right?
Yes.
Also, Al-Van said Granteed was needed to dispel@the calamity brought by something called@the Gate of Voda.
A gate... Could it be...
The <Cross Gate>...?
Aviano Base - Cafeteria
Tenia
Look, look, there's so much on the menu!@What should I eat first?
Melua
Tenia, what do you mean, first...
Katia
So it's not just one thing.
It's a rare chance, so I'm eating as much as I can!
Weren't you eating something a minute ago?
Got a problem with that?
No, not really.
Then don't butt in.@Don't spoil my fun.
I'm not trying to... But is it really okay@to eat that much all the time?@I mean, for your, uh...
Ah, Touya.
Ugh...
Tenia?
Don't ask that!
Ow!
It's your fault, Touya!@You're paying for my food here! Got it?!
...Okay, okay.
Lively bunch. I knew who it was right away.
Akimi... You here to eat too?
We already ate.@We've got a job to do on the Hagane now.
But Akimi, that package you're holding...
This? Osso buco, to go.
What's that?
Braised veal shank. It's the specialty here.@I heard about it from Lieutenant Aqua,@who used to be stationed at this base.
Then that's what I'm having first!
Are you taking it to someone, Akimi?
Yeah, to Sally and Sieg on the Hagane.
Huh? What do you mean?
The Hagane's taking custody of those two,@the same as Fairy.
I see...
When Crystal Dragoon attacked this base,@Sally and Sieg intercepted it in their own units.
You two weren't there?
Not when it attacked.@We'd gone to investigate an unidentified object@that fell on a mountain called Monte di Lupo.
That's where we fought forces from@the <Ze Balmary Empire>.
You mean...
The so-called <Aerogators>.
The ones we fought were apparently artificial humans@called Balshem, under <Euzeth> Gozzo, who worked@behind the scenes in <The Sealing War>...
(Besides the Fury, Gadisword and@Dark Brain's remnants, people like that@are on the move too...)
Well, we're heading back to the Hagane.
Yeah.
Okay, Touya!@Osso buco, osso buco!
Jeez... All right, all right.
Hagane - Hangar
Eric
I'm glad the Saber Booster@made it here safely.
Jinpu
It's a long way from Japan to here...@I was sweating bullets that we'd get@attacked on the way.
Jinpu!
Hey, you made it. The Saber Booster's@finished, as you can see.
Oh, it has the stabilizers we were@going to omit. And that canopy...
They even got the cockpit installed in time?
Yeah, thanks to the guys at the main office@working their butts off.
So did they fix the output problem too?@Can we use all the enhanced weapons?
The FF loadout, more or less...@One of the GG weapons still needs tuning,@so it's unusable.
I see...
But Soul Saber's own output goes up, right?
That's right, but you'll probably hit problems@at full power. It's a prototype built to test@that kind of stuff in the first place.
Then let's hurry up with@the setup and fitting.
You don't have to tell me, but it won't@be ready in time for the next operation.
Yeah, I know.
I'll lend a hand as well, I will.
Whaaat!?
What, you don't want me to?
N-No, it's just... Having Dr. Wan, who helped@develop the Granzon, help us out...@It's an honor.
Don't you have to analyze <Ariard>?
Right now I've got Sleeping Beauty looking into@the markings and warnings all over the unit and@translating them. So my hands are free, they are.
I'll have Clifford and Minaki help too, I will.@If we all pitch in, it'll be done in no time.
That's a big help.@First, we'll attach the Booster with the FF loadout.@Let's get right to it.
Simulator Room
(I can dodge Al-Van's attack from last time@perfectly now. With this, next time...)
Holding a solo review session instead of resting?
What about you, Lieutenant?
Let's call it looking after my subordinates.
No need.
Cold as ever.@Truth is, someone told me you were here.
Who?
Said they'd be right back... Ah, here they are.
Lieutenant Calvina, please get some rest.
Glacies told me before not to give up on talking.@Are you telling me to step down?
No, that's not what I mean.
I agree you should rest.@Pushing yourself too hard never ends well.
No need to worry. I don't intend to die...@That's right, there's no way I'll die.
Brooding isn't good for you either, you know?
Back when they called me White Lynx,@I thought I'd go as far as I could, and if I died@in battle, then so be it.
But I can't die now. I can't afford to.@Not until I kill him. So I won't lose.@I'll fight harder than ever before.
...I understand.@Then I'll leave this here.@Drink it if you like.
I've been smelling it for a while... Is that cocoa?
Yes. Well, see you.
(What, she's leaving already?)
(...A little strong. Melua would love it, though.)
...Was that really all right?
Yes... If she gets even a little of what she's feeling@off her chest, the pressure will drop. Case in point,@she didn't refuse the cocoa I brought her.
Heh, you'd make a good counselor.
That's not really me.
Then why do you care so much about her?
This goes for Touya and the others too...@Including the link between the <Sympathia> and@the Cytron System, it feels like a strange bond.
I see.
Besides... they're the ones who'll greatly shape@how the fight with the Fury turns out.
Yeah, you're right.
Hagane - Commander's Office
Miles
...Earlier, I informed the Joint Chiefs of Staff@that Granteed may be deeply connected@to the Cross Gate.
If, as Al-Van Ranks said, Granteed is needed@to dispel the calamity brought on@by the Cross Gate...
Will we be the ones to verify that?
With the Fury's identity and goals still unclear,@I can't say.
Then it looks like we'll go on@playing the decoy.
Indeed. The next time Al-Van Ranks appears,@capture him at all costs.
Judging by his exchanges with Calvina Coulange,@we should be able to get information@about the Fury out of that man.
Roger.
Then, once resupply is complete,@we'll transfer to Berlin and wipe out the Lamaris.
It's an easier mission than Operation Triumph.@Carry it out swiftly.
Sir!
Eita

Total remaining?
One Kaana type, seven Lamaris.
I hope no third party shows up...
Eun

Prepare for anti-air attack!

Roger!
Calvina Coulange!
Jua-Mu!

I'm gonna finish you off here for sure!

It's your fault!@Because you went and stayed alive, he...!
Recovering the Throne Unit is for the Fury's future!@Finishing you off is for Lord Al-Van!
Shut up! Like you could ever take me!
Ha! I'm not who I used to be!@I'm a Knight now, piloting a Raftclans!
But you can't even use that knockoff properly!@You can't move it on your own, can you?! Huh?!@You're the one who's gonna croak! Not me!
I'll send you to the Ashurey people@who burned up like trash!
Jua-Muuu!!
Calvina, please calm down!
Calvina, calm down!@I can't make corrections like this!
No, Calvina. Please keep a cool head.
You just shut up and support me!
Hey, hey!@This is no time to be fighting each other!
Outsiders stay out of it too!
Outsiders...? What kind of thing is that to say?!
Jeez... Maybe the cocoa was too weak?
I'm sorry.
Nah, it's not something you need to apologize for.
...It seems they're not using that trick again.
Too early to play their joker... is that it?
But if Granteed goes somewhere else while this@is going on, wouldn't that defeat the whole point...?
Either way, we can't take our time.@As long as Lamaris remain, Dark Brain's@remnants could appear.
All units, listen. I'm going after Bellzelute.
Junior Knight
Lord Jua-Mu, our top priority is@recovering Granteed, but...
I'm leaving that to you.
B-But...
It's fine. This is your chance to earn glory.@You've got family in cold sleep too, don't you?
Do it for your kin sleeping on Gaw-La.@Go!
Jua-Mu!@I'll beat you and drag Al-Van out!
E-Even if I never become a Knight,@my life is a foundation for the Fury...!!
(...Tough luck.@But it's not a pointless death.)
All Lamaris in the battle zone are gone!
I hope this situation is enough to purify them...
Sean
I think we'd best assume they'll reappear later.
Nice bite, Calvina!@But this is where it starts!
Not yet! This is where it starts!
You're not getting away!
You fell right for it!
You were after a one-on-one duel?!
That's right, so I could beat you as a Knight!!
What kind of knight are you?!@You slaughtered everyone at Ashurey!
Who cares how many lower life-forms die?!
What!?
That's all Earthlings are to us!@You could've been wiped out ages ago!
A plan to use people like that deserved to be crushed!@The Ashurey people had it coming!!
Juaaaa-Mu!!
Gwaah! Wh-Why, you!!
Not even Al-Van could dodge that!
Never! Never say his name again!!
I'll avenge everyone you killed!!
Wh-What?!
Prepare yourself!!
Uwah! Uwaaaaah!!
Aaaaaah!!
What!?
B-Bellzelute!!
How did she end up getting beaten?!
N-No way!
Raji
This time particle reading...!
He used that trick!
But the time lag wasn't that big...!
Time only skipped a tiny bit...?
Bellzelute isn't moving! This is bad!
I... I used Larseilam...!!
Ah... Aah... Uuugh...!!
Wh-Whoaaaaah!!
L-Lord Jua-Mu?!@Tch, retreat!
Squire
Fury units leaving the battle zone!
Azuki
Bellzelute appears heavily damaged!@Neither pilot is responding!
Hurry and recover the unit!@Send medics to the deck!
(...If he could use that trick,@why didn't he do it from the start?)
(And he could have finished her off if he'd wanted to.@So why did he retreat...?)
Jua-Mu!@You're gonna tell me what the Fury's after,@and what you people know about me!
Shut up! My target is that woman!@I've got no time to deal with you right now!
I'll never forgive you people!
You hate us that much? Want us dead that bad?!@Well, you're the one who's gonna die!
(We've fought four Raftclans so far...@and yet only one has used that trick.)
(There are a few things I can infer.@But I'd like just a bit more information.)
Move it, trash! You're in my way!
Jua-Mu! You never learn, do you?!
Stay out of my way!@The first one I'm killing today is that woman!
I'm taking down Calvina for Lord Al-Van!@I couldn't care less about you!
That's no reason to let you go...!
Don't think you can beat us@just 'cause you're in a Raftclans!
I'll deal with you after I finish off Calvina!@Back off!
I won't let you get Lieutenant Calvina!
You're a pain! Don't think you'll make it@home alive facing a Raftclans!
Ha!@Like that unit could take on a Raftclans!@You must really want to die!
Talk while you still can!
Hagane - Sickbay
Ugh... Mm...
Katia...!
You're awake...
What... happened to me...? Where is this...?
The Hagane's sickbay.
You have no serious injuries,@but you'll need bed rest for a while.
Um, what about Calvina...?
Her injuries are worse than yours, and she's being@treated. She's still unconscious, but her life@isn't in danger. Don't worry.
Y-Yes...
You were both lucky.@Bellzelute got wrecked, though...
Huh...
Apparently, aside from the area around the cockpit@and the Orgone Extractor, it's mostly useless.
I... see.
Anyway, just get some rest for now.
Yes... I think I will...
Ugh... Ungh...
Tenia...!
Wh-What... happened to me...? Where am I...?
The Hagane's sickbay.@There's nothing to worry about now.
What about Calvina...?
Her injuries are worse than yours, and she's being@treated. She's still unconscious, but her life@isn't in danger. So don't worry.
Y-Yeah...
You were both lucky.@Bellzelute was wrecked, though...
I see...
Anyway, just rest for now.@I'll bring you something to eat later.
Then... osso buco would be nice...@It was so good...
Sure.
Melua...!
You were both lucky.@Bellzelute got wrecked, though...
It... took the hit for us,@didn't it...
Yes...
...There's no doubt it can't be used repeatedly@in a short span, but the timing of when he used@that trick is puzzling...
The simple answer would be that he did it@to dodge Calvina's attack.
But despite Jua-Mu's clear intent@to kill Calvina, he left without@finishing her off.
Yeah... It didn't look like he was showing mercy.
Jua-Mu said he'd become a Knight.@From that...
We can infer that Fury Knights may be forbidden@from using that trick, for reasons apart from@its functional limits.
Because it wouldn't make for a fair fight,@it's considered taboo among the Knights?
And that's why Al-Van Ranks@never used it until now?
It's possible.
Jua-Mu broke a Knight's taboo to survive,@got shaken up and retreated...@I guess you could read it that way.
But after this outcome,@there's a good chance the Fury will send@people who aren't Knights.
Raji, how's the countermeasure coming?
If all goes as planned, it'll be assembled in five days.
I see... I hope the Fury doesn't move@before it gets to us.
But we won't know if it works@until we try it.
Even so, it's far better than nothing.@After Bellzelute, we can't afford@to lose Granteed too.
...Major, there may be something@we can do about Bellzelute.
Is that true?
Yes... I'll take it up with my superiors.
Hagane: Bridge
Lamaris appearing in the west of the city too!@Seven of them!
Nngh, so the purification wasn't complete...!
Commander, we'll begin the attack immediately.
Very well. This time, make certain the Lamaris@are annihilated.
Rabulpaila - Interior
Herluga
Vort, I am giving you the mission to recover@the Siebe Drive. Head to Earth at once.
Understood...
Reggiane
You understand Lord Herluga's intent, don't you?
That I take responsibility for my subordinates' blunder?
That's right. While you're getting the Siebe Drive back,@dispose of the traitors with your own hands.@Otherwise...
...I understand.
Then go.
By your leave.
...Are you sure we can leave it to him?@If you order it, I will go as well.
I cannot leave the defense of Rabulpaila thin.@And the only one whose skill rivals yours@is that man.
But Vort knows the truth of the matter.
It makes no difference if the Earthlings learn it.@Even if the traitors spread the word,@here, information control will make it mere drivel.
There's one more concern...@The relationship between Vort and Fairy.
I know.@We'll test whether that man will truly become my@right hand. If he's of two minds, he's just a pawn.
